title: HeadCarve
description: Drops the player's head from the explosion of a charged creeper
body:
# What is it? #
This datapack drop the heads of the players **ONLY when they die from a charged creeper**. The dropped head matches the skin of the player at the time of death. If the player later changes their skin, the appearance of the head will remain the same.


# How install it ? #

On Singleplayer :

- Download the file corresponding to your game version

- Go into your game files, in saves/name of your world/datapacks and juste drop the file you downloaded

On a Server :

- Do the same thing as Single player but drop the file in your server name/world/datapacks

# Compatibility # 
HeadCarve should work anywhere as long as Minecraft is in premium mode. Also compatible with Geyser servers.
